environment: Node.js complete application VM and shared DOM stub
limitations: No browser layout, physical input, native confirmation, file picker or Save As verification.

results.name: Project actions are attached to the existing project bar and no workflow popup is constructed
Gameplay navigation opens the existing Scene settings without replacing controls or compiling
Cancelling New Project preserves project references, undo history, save identity and running ROM
Confirming New Project creates a blank Scene in one undo step with no inherited runtime
Open Forge ROM uses its registered file input and cancellation retains the entire workspace
Malformed and unrelated ROM files are rejected before replacement confirmation or mutation
Confirmed Forge ROM input opens one editable project and keeps the Scene gameplay controls live
A newer ROM selection wins and a late older read cannot replace it or add history
Confirming a blank project invalidates an outstanding ROM read before it can prompt or import
Cancelling New Project does not silently discard an already selected ROM file
Read failures and oversized files release the input without confirming or changing project state
A failed Scene gameplay build exposes the shared build log beside the same settings
